class.name: SteamSocketConnection
class.brief_description: An owned standalone connection for authenticated Steam packets.
class.description: An incoming connection becomes ready after [signal connected]. A successful outgoing operation returns an already connected handle. Use [member steam_id] to authorize game data and apply your own protocol bounds.

method.name: is_connected
method.description: Returns whether the exact live connection passed Steam identity and encryption checks.

method.name: get_steam_id
method.description: Returns the certified account of the live peer.

method.name: send
method.description: Queues one message from 1 byte to 32 KiB after authentication. Both directions allow up to 128 frames and 256 KiB per second. [constant ERR_BUSY] reports SDK backpressure or an exhausted outbound budget.

method.name: path
method.description: Returns metrics from the current live socket or [code]null[/code] without a verified path.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes this exact socket, including a pending incoming handshake.

members.member: Canonical certified remote SteamID64 while connected. Empty before connection and after retirement.

signal.name: connected
signal.description: Emitted once an accepted incoming connection is encrypted and has a certified account.

signal.name: received
signal.description: Emitted with a copied packet from the live authenticated socket. Reliable receive overload closes the connection. Unreliable overload can drop packets.

signal.name: closed
signal.description: Emitted after the socket has been retired. [constant OK] indicates a local close, [constant ERR_SKIP] indicates scope retirement, and other values report a transport or policy failure.
